name: multiapi/arco-laravel
description: Laravel integration for Arco (Octane on AWS Lambda Web Functions)

suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: Required by the SQS queue (Laravel's sqs driver) when Arco deploys queues
suggest.ext-pcntl: Gives queue jobs on Lambda a time limit (present in Arco's runtime)
suggest.ext-curl: Used by arco:work to talk to the Lambda Runtime API (present in Arco's runtime)
suggest.multiapi/arco: The Arco CLI (install with --dev); it loads LaravelPreset when building and deploying
suggest.laravel/tinker: Required by arco tinker (installed by default in Laravel apps)
